title: Austin Housing Support for Low-Income Families
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   Approved a $125,000 budget increase for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation.
*   Designated these new funds to enhance community housing development programs.
*   Authorized a $500,000 loan to build Cottage Community, a 30-unit home complex for low-income families.

BOARD OF DIRECTORS' MEETING
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING MINUTES
THURSDAY, APRIL 7,2005
The Board of Directors of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) was convened on
Thursday, April 7, 2005, in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 301 W. 2- Street, Austin, Texas.
The following were the AHFC items considered by the Austin Housing Finance Corporation's
Board of Directors.
President Wynn called the meeting to order at 4:48 p.m.
AHFC-1 
Approve the minutes of the March 3,2005 Board meeting of the Austin Housing Finance
Corporation.
The minutes for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation meeting of March 3,2005
were approved on Vice President Goodman's motion, President Wynn's second on a
5-0 vote. Board Members Dunkerley and Slusher were off the dais.
AHFC- 2 
Approve a resolution amending the Austin Housing Finance Corporation Fiscal Year
2004-2005 Budget by increasing the Grant Operating Budget by $125,000, and
authorizing the negotiation and execution of an amendment to the Fiscal Year 2004-2005
Service Agreement with the City of Austin by increasing the contract by $125,000 for a
total contract amount not to exceed $13,699,670 to be used for operating the City's
Community Housing Development Organization (CHDO) Capacity Building Activity.
(Funding is available from the Grant Operating Budget, from the HOME Investment
Partnership Program for Fiscal Year 2004-2005.) (Related Item 9)
Resolution No. 20050407-AHFC002 was approved on Board Member Alvarez*
motion, Board Member Thomas' second on a 6-0 vote. Board Member Dunkerley
was off the dais.
AHFC-3 
Authorize the negotiation and execution of a federally-funded Rental Housing
Development Assistance Program deferred-payment, forgivable loan in an amount not to
exceed $500,000 to COMMUNITY PARTNERSHIP FOR THE HOMELESS, INC., for
the development of a 30-unit housing development for low-income families known as
Cottage Community and located at 10620 Dessau Road. (Funding is available in the
Fiscal Year 2004-2005 Austin Housing Finance Corporation budget allocation of the City
of Austin Housing Trust Fund under the Rental Housing Development Assistance
Program.)
The motion authorizing the negotiation and execution of a federally funded Rental
Housing Development Assistance Program was approved on Board Member
Slusher'i motion, Board Member Alvarez* second on a 7-0 vote.
The meeting was adjourned without objection at 4:58 p.m.
